$comment: JEDEC JESD79-3 (DDR3 SDRAM) conformance rules. This file is the human-reviewable CATALOG: id, what the rule requires, severity, and the standard section it comes from. The executable logic lives in spec_conformance.py, keyed by id. Split this way so someone holding the standard can audit the rules without reading Python.
$provenance: Values and relations transcribed from JESD79-3F. Relational rules (tRC = tRAS + tRP, tFAW >= 4*tRRD, CWL-vs-tCK banding) are structural and stable across revisions. Absolute speed-bin and tRFC numbers should be spot-checked against the standard before being cited in a report — they are the most likely place for a transcription error, and are marked confidence 'verify'.

rules.title: tRC equals tRAS + tRP
rules.requires: Row cycle time must be exactly the sum of active time and precharge time.

rules.title: tFAW at least 4x tRRD
rules.requires: The four-activate window must be able to contain four minimum-spaced activates.

rules.title: tRRD floor
rules.requires: tRRD >= max(4*tCK, 7.5ns) for a 1KB page; 6ns floor for a 512B page.

rules.title: tWTR floor
rules.requires: tWTR >= max(4*tCK, 7.5ns).

rules.title: tRTP floor
rules.requires: tRTP >= max(4*tCK, 7.5ns).

rules.title: tCCD is 4 clocks
rules.requires: CAS-to-CAS delay is exactly 4 nCK for DDR3 (BL8).

rules.title: tWR is 15ns
rules.requires: Write recovery time is fixed at 15ns across all DDR3 speed bins.

rules.title: CWL legal for tCK
rules.requires: CAS write latency must fall in the band the standard assigns to this clock period.

rules.title: tRFC matches device density
rules.requires: Refresh cycle time is set by density: 512Mb=90ns, 1Gb=110ns, 2Gb=160ns, 4Gb=300ns, 8Gb=350ns.

rules.title: tREFI is 7.8us (or 3.9us extended)
rules.requires: Average refresh interval is 7.8us at normal temperature, 3.9us in the extended range.

rules.title: CL/tRCD/tRP consistent with a real speed bin
rules.requires: The CL-tRCD-tRP triple must correspond to a published DDR3 speed bin at this tCK.

rules.title: RESET# hold at least 200us
rules.requires: RESET# must be held low for >=200us during power-up.

rules.title: CKE low at least 500us after RESET# de-assert
rules.requires: CKE must remain low for >=500us after RESET# goes high.

rules.title: tXPR floor
rules.requires: tXPR >= max(5*tCK, tRFC + 10ns).

rules.title: tZQinit at least 512 clocks
rules.requires: Initial ZQ calibration requires >=512 nCK before the device is ready.

rules.title: Mode register load order MR2, MR3, MR1, MR0
rules.requires: The initialization MRS sequence must load MR2, then MR3, then MR1, then MR0 last.

rules.title: MR0 asserts DLL reset during init
rules.requires: The MR0 write in the init sequence must request a DLL reset.

rules.title: DDR3 has 8 banks
rules.requires: bank_bits must be 3 — DDR3 devices have exactly 8 banks.

rules.title: Burst length is 8 or chopped 4
rules.requires: DDR3 supports BL8 and BC4 only.

rules.title: Density matches addressing
rules.requires: 2^(row+col+bank) * device_width must equal the stated device density.

rules.title: Page size is 1KB or 2KB
rules.requires: 2^column_bits * device_width / 8 must be a legal DDR3 page size.

rules.title: tCK agrees across sections
rules.requires: timing_model.tCK_ns must equal clocking_model.ddr_clock_period_ns.

rules.title: Derived cycle counts match their nanosecond values
rules.requires: Every $derived_cycles entry must equal ceil(param_ns / tCK).

rules.title: MR0 CAS latency matches the timing model
rules.requires: initialization_sequence.mode_registers.MR0.cas_latency_cycles must equal timing_model.CL_cycles.

rules.title: MR2 CAS write latency matches the timing model
rules.requires: initialization_sequence.mode_registers.MR2.cas_write_latency_cycles must equal timing_model.CWL_cycles.
